verdict.rationale: CIPO's own pages list an "IP Horizons – Bulk data" offering, "Canadian IP databases and downloadable bulk data", and a patents entry to "download patent office records". Together these show official bulk public-data extracts that need no scraping. The evidence is only link titles and does not describe the datasets themselves. Missing for 10: details on dataset formats, coverage (trademarks vs patents vs designs) and update frequency, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the downloads work.
